chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad ibn 'Amir narrated to me from al-Mu'alla ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Jumhur al-'Ami, from someone whom he mentioned, from them (the Imams (peace be upon him)), who said:
Whoever goes to the Ziyarah of the grave of al-Husayn (peace be upon him) on the Day of 'Ashura is like one who was ensanguined with his blood in front of him.

key_terms.بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ: In front of him / in his presence

ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual reward for visiting Imam Husayn's grave on Ashura?
ai.summary: In *Kamil al-Ziyarat*, Ibn Qulawayh conveys that visiting Imam al-Husayn’s grave on the Day of ‘Ashura grants the merit of those who physically shed their blood in his defense, emphasizing the continuity of the Karbala sacrifice. This narration underscores the Shia theological view that spiritual participation through Ziyarah is equivalent to physical martyrdom, linking the pilgrim directly to the primordial covenant of the Ahl al-Bayt.

en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 4. Ḥusain ibn Muḥammad ibn ‘Āmir narrated to me from Mu’allā ibn Muḥammad, from Muḥammad ibn Jumhūr Al-‘Ammi, from someone whom he mentioned, from them (the infallible Imams (a.s.)), who said:
Those who go to the Ziyārah of the grave of Ḥusain (a.s.) on the Day of ‘Āshūrā are like those who were ensanguined with their blood in front of him.
